subject.title: Feature Request: TUI Notification When Agent Completes (Sound/Desktop Alert)

question: Should OpenClaw add an opt-in TUI completion-alert surface, and which notification modes and config shape should core own?
rationale: The request adds new user-facing behavior and config surface across local and Gateway TUI modes; automation should not choose desktop-vs-bell semantics, platform scope, or shell-backed notification policy.

options.title: Approve narrow default-off TUI alerts
options.body: Add a default-off TUI completion notifier with a small mode set, safe platform handling, docs, and focused TUI regression coverage.

options.title: Wait for broader alert architecture
options.body: Keep this open but defer implementation until session activity/watchdog and urgent alert contracts settle.

options.title: Decline core notification surface
options.body: Close after maintainer decision if completion alerts should remain external scripts, companion apps, or plugins rather than OpenClaw TUI core.

recommendation.title: Approve narrow default-off TUI alerts
recommendation.body: Add a default-off TUI completion notifier with a small mode set, safe platform handling, docs, and focused TUI regression coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: Current blame and older TUI status-line history make steipete the strongest routing candidate for the TUI status/config product boundary.
